equation: u_t + (u^2/2)_x = (nu/pi) u_xx  (PDEBench Burgers convention: the parameter nu, called 'epsilon' in PDEBench, is divided by pi)
limiter: PDEBench VLlimiter (alpha=2, MC-type) on cell-centred slopes
numerical_flux: Rusanov/Murman with speed |(uL+uR)/2| for advection; central 2-point flux for diffusion
time_integration: explicit 2-stage midpoint (predictor dt/2, corrector dt), dt = CFL*min(dx/max|u|, 0.5 dx^2/(nu/pi)), clipped to land on output times
dtype: float64 (PDEBench default is float32; float64 chosen so finite-difference derivatives in the inverse solver are not dominated by round-off)
nu_meaning: PDEBench 'epsilon'; effective diffusivity D = nu/pi is in [0.00318, 0.0318]

initial_condition.family: u0(x) = sum_{k in modes} a_k sin(2 pi k x + phi_k)
initial_condition.note: PDEBench draws 2 of 4 modes with amp U(0,1) and random abs/window/sign; we use a fixed known 3-mode family per the proposal, with exact periodic wavenumbers 2 pi k / L (PDEBench divides by xc[-1]-xc[0], which is slightly non-periodic).

observation.operator: periodic linear interpolation of cell-centre values at sensor x
